turns.in_depth_section:
- The patient's primary antiretroviral regimen consists of lamivudine/zidovudine and nevirapine [3][4], which are standard components in many HIV management protocols.
- Isoniazid is prescribed as part of the treatment for tuberculosis prophylaxis or active infection, with a plan to stop it once completed [2][31].
- Dapsone was initiated on 2025-12-18 specifically to treat an active case of dermatophytosis [37][38].
- The patient's CD4 count is currently 298 cells/uL (CD4% 17%) as of 2025-12-18, which informs the clinical decision to stop PCP prophylaxis because it is above the threshold of 200 [30][73][74].
